decisions.rationale: Full name of one specific disease (Van der Woude syndrome) in the title, not further categorized.
'disease' in 'the disease mutation' is a very general term and is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 - General terms

decisions.rationale: Full name of the specific disease Van der Woude syndrome in the abstract, referring to one defined disease.
Abbreviation VWS for Van der Woude syndrome is annotated as its own mention, separate from the long form.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 - Synonymous mentions and abbreviations

decisions.rationale: 'autosomal dominant craniofacial disorder' describes a family of multiple specific diseases, analogous to the 'autosomal recessive disease' example.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class; Examples 10

decisions.rationale: 'cleft lip and / or cleft palate' contains two separate disease mentions (cleft lip and cleft palate) in one contiguous string.
'lip pits' names a specific, defined congenital anomaly/condition with no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease (grey-area clinical feature)

decisions.rationale: 'hypodontia' names a specific dental condition (tooth agenesis) with a single definition.
'VWS' in 'All VWS families' is used as a modifier of the noun 'families' rather than as a standalone disease name.
'disease' in 'the disease gene' is a very general term and is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 - General terms

decisions.rationale: 'VWS' in 'the VWS gene' modifies the noun 'gene' and is not a standalone disease mention.
'VWS' in 'multiplex VWS families' modifies the noun 'families'.
'VWS' in 'the VWS candidate gene region' modifies the noun phrase 'candidate gene region'.
'VWS' in 'the VWS gene' modifies the noun 'gene'.
'VWS' in 'Caucasian VWS families' modifies the noun 'families'.
'VWS' in 'cases of VWS' is used as a standalone noun referring to the disease itself, an abbreviation of the specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; What to Annotate 6 - Abbreviations
